item.title: Sources: Bucs, Mayfield reach 3-year extension
item.description: The Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield have agreed to a three-year extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

item.title: Patriots RB Henderson, Seahawks safety Okada out for Super Bowl rematch
item.description: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson won't play in the regular-season opener against the Seahawks, while the defending Super Bowl champions may have to begin their title defense without two of their top three safeties.
item.dc:creator: Mike Reiss and Brady Henderson

item.title: Mahomes expected to start MNF opener, but Chiefs face issues at left tackle
item.description: Patrick Mahomes is expected to start the Chiefs' season opener Monday against the Broncos.
item.dc:creator: Nate Taylor
